solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Author Margaret's not right to act casually

indicators.note: not here says the following letter is missing from the author's surname

parts.note: Margaret Drabble is an English novelist

explanation.surface: A novelist is described as approaching her work in an easygoing way.
explanation.definitionFit: To dabble is to take part in something lightly, without serious commitment.

clue.text: Paper badly mounted beginning to crumple

indicators.note: badly signals that the letters of mounted, plus one more, are put together wrongly
beginning to means take only the opening letter of crumple

explanation.surface: A sheet of paper has been poorly framed and is starting to crease.
explanation.walkthrough: 'badly' scrambles MOUNTED together with C, the first letter from 'beginning to crumple'.
explanation.definitionFit: A document is an official or written paper, such as a certificate or record.

clue.text: Very drunk needing help to get up into bed

indicators.note: into says one piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: taken as written
a ladder is an aid for climbing upwards

explanation.surface: A drunk person needs assistance getting up into bed.
explanation.walkthrough: BLADDERED is British slang for very drunk.
explanation.definitionFit: British slang synonym for intoxicated, much like plastered or legless.

clue.text: Folly having fancy decoration around international body

indicators.note: around puts the ornamental word on either side of the organisation

parts.note: lacy describes something trimmed with delicate ornamentation
UN is the United Nations

explanation.surface: Someone ridicules elaborate ornament surrounding a global organisation as foolish.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words mean foolish or senseless behaviour, as synonyms.

clue.text: Awful wine tipped into grass

indicators.note: tipped into suggests pouring one thing inside another

parts.note: to grass is to inform on someone, as is to sing
hock is a German white wine

explanation.surface: Bad wine has been poured out onto the lawn.
explanation.walkthrough: 'grass' and 'sing' both mean inform to the police; HOCK is a Rhine wine.
explanation.definitionFit: Shocking is used as an intensifier meaning very bad or appalling.

clue.text: Being pernickety when there's a tonsorial problem?

definitions.meaning: making overly fine distinctions in argument
literally, ends of ..., a barber's concern

explanation.definitionFit: Quibbling over tiny distinctions is the idiomatic sense; split ends are the literal one.

clue.text: Talk when drinking port in carriage

indicators.note: drinking means taking something inside, so one word holds another

parts.note: chat is informal talk
Rio de Janeiro is a Brazilian port

explanation.surface: Conversation over a glass of port while riding in a coach.
explanation.definitionFit: A chariot is a horse-drawn vehicle, an ancient or ceremonial carriage.

clue.text: Some pink edition — as all our papers must be!

definitions.text: as all our papers must be

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A nod to the Financial Times, printed on pink paper, whose pages all need ink.
explanation.definitionFit: Printed newspapers must have ink applied, so every paper is marked with ink.

clue.text: Good list of competitors — top people here

parts.note: the entry is the set of those entered for a contest

explanation.surface: A strong field of competitors, with elite people among them.
explanation.definitionFit: The gentry are people of high social class, just below the nobility.

clue.text: A home by church seen in mountain range

parts.note: in means at home

explanation.surface: A house beside a church can be spotted among the mountains.
explanation.definitionFit: A chain of mountains is a connected series of peaks, a range.

clue.text: Islander, thin and gaunt, sheltering from violent rains

indicators.note: sheltering means protecting something within, so one piece goes inside
violent suggests turbulence, so the letters of rains are thrown about

parts.note: lank means lean and thin

explanation.surface: A thin, gaunt islander takes cover from a downpour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'violent' rearranges RAINS into SRIAN, which then holds LANK; 'from' links.
explanation.definitionFit: A Sri Lankan is a native of the island nation off southern India.

clue.text: Smug sightseer, foul when abroad

indicators.note: abroad means widely scattered, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A conceited tourist behaves badly on a trip overseas.
explanation.definitionFit: Self-righteous means complacently sure of one's own moral superiority, close to smug.

clue.text: Examination claimed to be corrupt

indicators.note: corrupt suggests the letters are spoiled and rearranged

explanation.surface: An inspection is alleged to have been rigged.
explanation.definitionFit: A medical is a physical check-up by a doctor, a kind of examination.

clue.text: Son — deceptive type, someone on the slide

parts.note: a kidder is someone who fools or teases others

explanation.surface: A son is a liar, someone whose fortunes are declining.
explanation.definitionFit: One who skids is literally sliding, e.g. on ice.

clue.text: Invaders with no answer — you might expect that

indicators.note: with no means the piece that follows is dropped

parts.note: the Normans invaded England in 1066

explanation.surface: Invaders who never reply is just what one would predict.
explanation.definitionFit: A norm is the standard or usual state, what is typically expected.

clue.text: Chronicles written by quiet clergy

parts.note: P is piano, the musical direction for quiet
to chronicle is to recount or relate events

explanation.surface: Historical records penned by reserved churchmen.
explanation.definitionFit: Prelates are senior churchmen such as bishops, so they are clergy.

clue.text: Troubled emigrants moving in large numbers

indicators.note: troubled means disturbed, so the letters of the next word are stirred up

explanation.surface: Distressed migrants moving en masse.
explanation.definitionFit: Streaming describes people flowing continuously in a crowd, like a stream.

clue.text: City type is no mixer, fellow in seclusion

indicators.note: in seclusion pictures one piece shut away inside another

parts.note: a loner is someone who does not socialise
a don is a college fellow

explanation.surface: A city dweller who does not socialise, keeping himself apart.
explanation.definitionFit: A Londoner lives in London, the capital, so a type from a city.

clue.text: Agent given instruction to take away money from sporting event

parts.note: dele is the proofreader's mark meaning delete
the gate is the takings from spectators at a match

explanation.surface: A representative is told to remove takings from a match.
explanation.definitionFit: A delegate is a representative acting on behalf of others, an agent.

clue.text: Heartless lord concealing a scheme for northern region

indicators.note: concealing means holding something hidden inside
heartless removes the middle, leaving the outer letters of lord

parts.note: a plan is a scheme

explanation.surface: A cruel aristocrat hides a plot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Heartless' strips the middle letters from 'lord', and 'concealing' puts 'a scheme' inside what is left.
explanation.definitionFit: Lapland is the Arctic area of Scandinavia and Finland, a far-north region.

clue.text: Liveliness of small music group with new leader

indicators.note: new leader says the first letter is swapped for a different one

parts.note: a trio is a band of three musicians

explanation.surface: A little band's energy comes from a fresh frontman.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue does not specify the new first letter; the definition and crossings decide it.
explanation.definitionFit: Brio means vigour and spirit, as in the musical marking con brio.

clue.text: A matter for discussion associated with hypersensitivity

parts.note: a topic is a subject to be discussed

explanation.surface: A subject is up for debate linked to allergies.
explanation.definitionFit: Atopic describes a hereditary tendency to allergic reactions, such as eczema.

clue.text: City functioning within very short period

indicators.note: short means very is cut down to its first letter
within puts one piece inside the other

parts.note: an era is a period of time
on means working or operating

explanation.surface: A city is operating within a brief spell.
explanation.definitionFit: Verona is a city in northern Italy, setting of Romeo and Juliet.

clue.text: The last thing we'd expect to hear?

definitions.text: The last thing we'd expect to hear?

parts.words: The last thing we'd expect to hear?
parts.note: the Last Trump is the brass call heralding Judgment Day, literally the final sound anyone hears

explanation.walkthrough: The phrase normally means something surprising; here it alludes to the Last Trump of Judgment Day.
explanation.definitionFit: A brass instrument blown, in scripture, to signal the end of the world.

clue.text: Hesitation over foreign friend's sort of taste

indicators.note: in a down answer, over places the first piece above the second

parts.note: um is a sound of hesitation
ami is French for friend

explanation.surface: Pausing before judging a friend's taste abroad.
explanation.definitionFit: Umami is the savoury fifth basic taste, alongside sweet, sour, salt and bitter.

clue.text: One antelope leaping over river in the country

indicators.note: leaping over says the antelope jumps past the river to sit beyond it

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
an eland is a large African antelope

explanation.surface: A single antelope jumps a river within a nation.
explanation.definitionFit: Ireland is a nation, so a country in its own right.

clue.text: Co-operate with pal suffering terrible agony, penning brief line

indicators.note: penning means enclosing, so a letter is shut inside
terrible signals that pal and agony are jumbled together
brief cuts the word line down to its first letter

explanation.surface: Helping a friend who is in great pain, writing a short note.
explanation.walkthrough: 'suffering' is a link; 'terrible' alone signals the jumble, and 'brief line' is the usual abbreviation for line.
explanation.definitionFit: To play along is to go along with something, i.e. cooperate.

clue.text: Such stars would gather round saint for prayer

indicators.note: the answer, put around a saint, makes the prayer, so the saint is taken out of it

parts.note: an orison is a prayer

explanation.surface: Stars clustering round a holy figure in worship.
explanation.walkthrough: The constellation's letters around S give ORISON, so removing S from ORISON leaves the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Orion is a constellation, the Hunter, so a group of stars.

clue.text: Endless cold food? That's silly

indicators.note: endless means drop the final letter

parts.note: a chill is coldness
a dish is a prepared item of food

explanation.surface: Endlessly cold food is a ridiculous idea.
explanation.definitionFit: Childish means immature or foolish, behaving like a child.

clue.text: Person installing insulation may be one behind schedule

definitions.meaning: one who lags pipes or lofts with insulating material
one who lags, i.e. falls behind

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses of lag: to wrap pipes in insulation, and to trail behind.
